```yaml
name: Termux Tests

on:
  pull_request: null
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Sunday 00:00 UTC

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  base:
    name: Base requirements
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run tests in Termux container
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/workspace -w /workspace termux/termux:latest bash -lc '
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip && \
            pip3 install -r requirements.txt && \
            python3 run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer
          '

  full:
    name: Full requirements
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run tests in Termux container
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v ${{ github.workspace }}:/workspace -w /workspace termux/termux:latest bash -lc '
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip && \
            pip3 install -r requirements-full.txt && \
            python3 run-all-tests.py -vv --no-pause --no-buffer
          '
```
